description: Get the result of one voting (głosowanie) of the Sejm: title, topic, kind, required majority, totals of YES, NO and ABSTAIN votes, and the number of votes of each kind per club (votesByClub). Optionally also how each MP voted.

club.description: Return the individual votes of this club only, e.g. KO or PiS (the `id` from get-clubs); implies includeVotes

includeVotes.description: Also return how each MP voted (about 460 entries); defaults to false

sitting.description: Number of the plenary sitting (posiedzenie Sejmu): the `number` field from get-proceedings

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

votingNumber.description: Number of the voting within the sitting: the `votingNumber` field from get-votings or search-votings

name: get-voting

date.description: Date and time of the voting

kind.description: ELECTRONIC, TRADITIONAL or ON_LIST (voting on a list of options)

majorityType.description: Majority required, e.g. SIMPLE_MAJORITY or ABSOLUTE_MAJORITY

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

listVotes.description: Votes per option for votings on a list

vote.description: YES, NO, ABSTAIN, ABSENT; VOTE_VALID for votings on a list

votes.description: How each MP voted, when requested

votesByClub.description: Number of votes of each kind (YES, NO, ABSTAIN, ABSENT…) per club

votingNumber.description: Voting number within the sitting, used by get-voting

title: Get a voting
